blocks.prompt: 8 Given the function \(f(x) = 3^{x}\) and its transformed function \(g(x) = 3^{x - 2} + 1\), draw the graphs of both functions on the same coordinate plane and compare their shapes.
blocks.explanation:
Yahan do exponential graphs banane hain aur un ki shakal ka muqabla karna hai.
Diya kya hai? \(f(x) = 3^{x}\) aur \(g(x) = 3^{x - 2} + 1\).
Find kya karna hai? Dono graphs ek hi plane par, aur farq aur mushabahat (similarity) batana.
Rule: \(g(x) = f(x - 2) + 1\), yani formula \(y = f(x - h) + k\) jahan \(h = 2\) aur \(k = 1\).
Plan: dono ki table, graph, phir shakal, asymptote, domain aur range ka muqabla.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(f(x) = 3^{x}\), \(g(x) = 3^{x - 2} + 1\).
Karna: dono graphs ek hi coordinate plane par bana kar shakal compare karna.
Tareeqa: pehle pehchaniye ke \(g\) kis tarah \(f\) se bana: power mein \(x - 2\) (andar, \(h = 2\), daayen) aur bahar \(+1\) (\(k = 1\), oopar).

f ki table
\[f(-1) = \tfrac{1}{3},\ f(0) = 1\]
\[f(1) = 3,\ f(2) = 9\]
Kyun: 3 ki powers; negative power ka matlab ulta: \(3^{-1} = \frac{1}{3}\).

g ki table
\[g(1) = \tfrac{1}{3} + 1 = \tfrac{4}{3}\]
\[g(2) = 1 + 1 = 2\]
\[g(3) = 3 + 1 = 4\]
Kyun: \(f\) ka har point 2 daayen aur 1 oopar jata hai: \((0, 1) \to (2, 2)\), \((1, 3) \to (3, 4)\). Isi liye \(g\) ki table bhi \(f\) ki table se seedhi ban gayi.

Asymptotes, domain aur range
\[f:\ y = 0,\quad R_{f} = \,]0, \infty[\]
\[g:\ y = 1,\quad R_{g} = \,]1, \infty[\]
Dono ka domain \(]-\infty, \infty[\) hai.
Kyun: 1 oopar shift ne asymptote aur range dono ko 1 oopar utha diya. Daayen shift se domain nahin badla kyun ke domain pehle hi poori real line hai.
Dhyan dein: \(g\) kabhi 1 ke barabar nahin hota, kyun ke \(3^{x - 2}\) kabhi zero nahin hota.

Shakal ka muqabla
Dono barhte hue exponential curves hain aur in ki shakal bilkul ek jaisi hai; \(g\) sirf \(f\) ko 2 daayen aur 1 oopar sarkane se bana. Dono curves ek dafa milte hain, jahan \(3^{x} = 3^{x - 2} + 1\), yani \(3^{x} = \frac{9}{8}\), \(x = \log_{3}\frac{9}{8} \approx 0.11\).
Kyun: shift sirf jagah badalti hai, shakal kabhi nahin. Jaise kursi ko kamre mein ek kone se doosre kone le jayein to kursi wahi rehti hai.

Tasdeeq:
\[g(2) = 3^{0} + 1 = 2\]
yani \(g\) par \((2, 2)\), \(f\) ke \((0, 1)\) ka hi naya roop hai.
blocks.final_answer: \(g(x) = 3^{x - 2} + 1\), \(f(x) = 3^{x}\) ka graph hai jo 2 units daayen aur 1 unit oopar sarak gaya: shakal wahi, jagah alag (asymptote \(y = 0\) ki jagah \(y = 1\), range \(]0, \infty[\) ki jagah \(]1, \infty[\)).

answer_figure.alt: The curves f(x) = 3 to the power x through (0, 1) and (1, 3), and g(x) = 3 to the power (x - 2) plus 1 through (2, 2) and (3, 4), with the dashed horizontal asymptote y = 1 of g; the x-axis is the asymptote of f.
